contract: DELETE /api/sessions/:id. Delete an authorized historical session and close its live session if open; unknown ID returns 404 and disallowed user 403; retain media/progress and unrelated history.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
force is not applicable: session delete has no force/hard mode; a repeated delete answers 404.

invariants.contract: DELETE /api/sessions/:id by a user with the delete permission answers 200 with an empty body and removes that stored session; an open session is also closed without a user_session_closed event; media, progress and other sessions stay. Unknown or malformed ids answer 404 and a user without the delete permission 403.
exceptions: Assertion leads only; missing normal/error/edge and state-transition proof must be supplied by the owning packet.
